entries.name: Stew Albert

expected_cases.convicted: Jailed during the Vietnam Day Committee anti-draft protests (1965-66)
expected_cases.sentence:
Incarceration during the Oakland anti-draft protests

Charges as recorded: Anti-draft / anti-war protest — the Vietnam Day Committee demonstrations, Oakland, California

updates.sentence: Served combined local sentences at Alameda County Rehabilitation Center, Santa Rita, beginning August 1, 1969; released October 4, 1969 with early-release credit. The contemporaneous FBI file says the sentences concerned offenses on three separate dates. This entry records that combined custody period, not a separate additional term for each offense. The existing undated 1965–66 protest record is preserved.

entries.rationale: FBI file 105-89231 section 2 part 2 page 17 confirms August 1, 1969 admission for sentences arising from three offense dates; section 3 page 16 explicitly records October 4, 1969 release. These are actual endpoints, not sentence arithmetic. Existing generic 1965–66 case is not overwritten.
